evidence: Judge agent+model pinned and shared: task/task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL openrouter, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=""; diff of the [verifier] tail against the frozen template task.toml is empty. All five judge.toml files carry only the expected judge = "claude-code" fallback (line 2) and no model/temperature/reasoning_effort/weight key in [judge] (grep found none). Pinned CLIs and browser: tests/Dockerfile (byte-identical to template) installs @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 16-22), harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31), and Chromium via the Playwright CLI bundled in the pinned @playwright/mcp, symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium (lines 33-39); every judge.toml launches playwright-mcp with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --headless --isolated. Shared tools: tests/tools/score.py (13de2b38...) and restart_mcp.py (03c1426f...) are sha256-identical to the frozen template; test.sh, environment/Dockerfile and tests/.dockerignore are also byte-identical. Fixed clock / graded time rules: no graded rule depends on the calendar date or run date. The only time rules are relative latencies (15 s live updates, 60 s polish watches), which functional/polish prompt.md 'Timed observations' run in a single browser_run_code_unsafe action with t0 = Date.now() after the trigger succeeds, 500 ms polling, explicit void definition and at most two repeats, completed met=false never repeated (matches Colderwater lessons 7/14). Seed timestamps are static (2026-07-01T10:07:00Z ...); the golden orders activity, messages and undo by autoincrement id (index.js:158,166,189,242,350), not by clock, and renders times with timeZone 'UTC' (app.js:21), so verifier TZ/date does not change any graded observable. Since no date-relative rule exists, the absence of a stated fixed clock in instruction/notes is not a defect for this row. Per the public row text, temperature and prompt-version markers are not required and the open verifier network ([verifier.environment] network_mode="public") is not a defect; the Internal sheet's older 'temperature 0, versioned prompt' annotation is superseded by the public row and SKILL profile (temperature in judge.toml is itself a defect). Adversarial: a broken app cannot exploit judge nondeterminism via unpinned versions (all pinned); a conforming app using a different clock/timezone or SSE vs polling cannot fail on time, because rules are latency-only and grading reads relative ms. Notes (not defects for this row): base images node:22-bookworm-slim / python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned not digest-pinned, apt packages unpinned, and npm -g transitive deps have no lockfile - all template-controlled and identical to template (workbook treats unpinned apt as NOTE). Out of row scope but observed: scored/functional/judge.toml:3-4 deviates from template (mode="individual", timeout=600 vs template batched/9000), justified in-file at line 24 as lead instruction and 'Not yet measured against a configured judge run' - belongs to template-preservation/budget rows; it does not affect pinning. No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so), so pinning is verified statically only; that is sufficient for this row, which is a static configuration property.
